testcase.name: Given no canEnable argument when updateBiometric true then defaults to enabled true()
Given canEnable false when updateBiometric true then biometricEnabled forced to false()
Given canEnable false when updateBiometric false then biometricEnabled stays false()
Given canEnable true when updateBiometric true then biometricEnabled becomes true()
Given biometric enabled when updateBiometric with canEnable false then disables it()
